title: HDFC Diners Club Miles credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A travel-centric Diners Club card rewarding flight and hotel bookings, offering global lounge access, and accelerated points for frequent flyers.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Get 15% discount and other benefits at some of the finest restaurants.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Dine from over 1400 offers with partners across the world.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: The insurance benefits include ₹1 crore air accident cover, ₹25 lakh emergency medical expenses cover, ₹9 lakh credit liability cover, and upto ₹50,000 travel insurance cover for baggage delay/loss.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Contact at 1800-266-9777 or schedule a call. You can also send a missed call to +91-9980970424 or email buyonline@hdfclife.in.
